entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia is an Islamic university in Nilai, Seremban, Negeri Sembilan, which is fully owned and funded by the Malaysian government. Being the 12th Public Institution of Higher Learning, it aims to spearhead knowledge and be the global reference centre for Islamic science.
